entry.name: jit.mo.fieldmask
entry.digest: Field mask for 3 plane jit.mo streams
entry.description: Field mask for 3 plane jit.mo streams. Calculates a mask value depending on distance from a defined spatial location. Can be used to perform arbitrary manipulations based on location
